title: AUTOPHAGE v1.4.0: A Bare-Metal Polymorphic x86-64 Galois-Field Genetic Engine with Six-Kernel Lean 4.35.0 Verification and 18-Gate Silicon Falsification
description: Zero-dependency C11 bare-metal x86-64 Galois-field genetic engine with 48 Pure Lean 4.35.0 machine-checked theorems (6-kernel Palomar Challenge/Solution contract, zero Mathlib, zero sorry, zero native_decide), 18-gate bare-metal silicon falsification suite with 6 planted negative mutants, dual-kernel bit-exact SHA-256 parity across Win64 PE and Linux ELF64, and companion AMS-LaTeX white paper. Dual-licensed Apache-2.0 (code/proofs) and CC-BY-4.0 (white paper/docs). Not externally peer-reviewed.
